t: Let's start the interview now. Tell me a little bit about yourself.
I would like to know where you live. Can you describe your home to me? What does it look like?
What do you usually do at home on weekends? Tell me about a typical weekend at home.
Tell me about a problem you had at home recently. What was it, and how did you solve it?
How is your current home different from the one you lived in before?
You indicated that you like watching movies. What kind of movies do you like, and why?
When and where do you usually watch movies? Who do you go with? Tell me about your typical movie routine.
Tell me about the most memorable movie you have ever seen. What was it about, and why was it memorable?
How have movies or movie theaters changed since you were young?
You said you like going to parks. Describe your favorite park. What does it look like?
What do you usually do when you go to the park? Who do you go with?
Tell me about a memorable experience you had at a park.
You indicated that you go to concerts. What kind of concerts do you like to go to?
What do you usually do before, during, and after a concert? Describe the whole process.
Tell me about the most memorable concert you have been to.
You indicated that you go to the beach. Describe a beach you like to visit. What does it look like?
What do you usually do at the beach? Describe a typical day there.
Tell me about a memorable or unexpected experience you had at the beach.
You indicated that you like listening to music. What kind of music do you like, and who are your favorite musicians?
When and where do you usually listen to music? How do you listen to it?
How did you first become interested in music? Tell me how your taste in music has changed.
You said you like cooking. What kind of food do you usually cook? Describe one of your favorite dishes.
How do you usually cook? Walk me through the steps from shopping to eating.
Tell me about a time something went wrong while you were cooking.
You indicated that you like reading. What kind of books do you like to read?
When and where do you usually read? Tell me about your reading habits.
Tell me about a book that left a strong impression on you.
You said you go jogging. Where do you usually jog? Describe the place.
Tell me about your jogging routine. How often do you jog, and what do you do before and after?
How did you start jogging? Tell me about the first time you went jogging.
You indicated that you go to the gym. Describe the gym you go to. What does it look like?
What do you usually do at the gym? Describe your typical workout.
Tell me about a memorable experience you had at the gym.
You said you ride a bike. Where do you usually ride, and what does your bike look like?
When do you usually ride your bike? Describe your typical ride.
Tell me about a memorable or difficult experience you had while riding your bike.
You indicated that you like to travel domestically. Where do you like to go in your country, and why?
What do you usually do to prepare for a trip? Tell me about your typical travel routine.
Tell me about a memorable trip you took in your country. Where did you go, and what happened?
You said you travel abroad. Which countries have you visited, and which did you like the most?
What do you usually do before an overseas trip? How do you plan it?
Tell me about a problem you had while traveling abroad and how you handled it.
You said you spend your vacations at home. What do you usually do during a vacation at home?
Tell me about your most recent vacation at home. What did you do, day by day?
What kind of housework do you usually do? Who does the housework at your home?
Tell me about a time you had to do a lot of housework. What did you do?
Tell me about the weather in your country. What are the seasons like?
Tell me about a time the weather caused a problem for you.
Describe a bank in your country. What does it look like, and what do people do there?
How has banking changed over the past 10 years?
How is recycling done in your country? What do people usually recycle?
Tell me about a time you had trouble with recycling.
What do you usually do on the internet? Which websites or apps do you use the most?
How has the internet changed people's lives compared to the past?
What kind of transportation do people use in your country? How do you usually get around?
Tell me about a problem you experienced with public transportation.
Tell me about a major holiday in your country. What do people do on that day?
Tell me about a memorable holiday from your childhood.
What do you do to stay healthy? Tell me about your healthy habits.
How are people's ideas about health today different from the past?
What kind of clothes do you usually wear? Describe your style.
How has fashion in your country changed over the years?
What kind of technology do you use every day? Which device is most important to you?
Tell me about a technology that has changed a lot since you were young.
Tell me about a popular food in your country. What does it taste like?
Tell me about a memorable meal you had recently.
I'd like to give you a situation and ask you to act it out. You want to see a movie with a friend. Call the theater and ask three or four questions about the movie and the showtimes.
I'm sorry, but there is a problem. When you get to the theater, you find that the tickets are sold out. Explain the situation to your friend and suggest two or three alternatives.
That's the end of the situation. Have you ever had a plan fall through because of a sold-out event or a cancellation? Tell me what happened.
I'd like to give you a situation and ask you to act it out. You want to go on a trip. Call a travel agency and ask three or four questions about a travel package.
I'm sorry, but there is a problem. You booked the trip, but something urgent came up and you cannot go. Call the agency, explain the situation, and suggest two or three solutions.
That's the end of the situation. Have you ever had to cancel or change a trip? Tell me about it.
I'd like to give you a situation and ask you to act it out. You want to join a gym. Call the gym and ask three or four questions about membership.
I'm sorry, but there is a problem. You joined the gym, but it is always too crowded and you can't use the machines. Talk to the manager, explain the problem, and suggest two or three solutions.
That's the end of the situation. Have you ever been unhappy with a service you paid for? What happened, and how did you deal with it?
I'd like to give you a situation and ask you to act it out. You want to have dinner with your family at a restaurant. Call the restaurant and ask three or four questions to make a reservation.
I'm sorry, but there is a problem. When you arrive, the restaurant has no record of your reservation. Explain the situation to the staff and suggest two or three ways to solve it.
That's the end of the situation. Tell me about a time something went wrong at a restaurant. What happened?
I'd like to give you a situation and ask you to act it out. You want to buy a new phone. Go to a store and ask the clerk three or four questions about the phone you want.
I'm sorry, but there is a problem. After buying the phone, you find that the screen is scratched. Call the store, explain the problem, and suggest two or three solutions.
That's the end of the situation. Have you ever bought something that turned out to be broken or disappointing? Tell me what happened.
I'd like to give you a situation and ask you to act it out. A friend invited you to a party. Call your friend and ask three or four questions about the party.
I'm sorry, but there is a problem. On the day of the party, you are sick and cannot go. Call your friend, explain the situation, and suggest two or three alternatives.
That's the end of the situation. Tell me about a time you had to cancel plans with a friend. What happened, and how did your friend react?
